Q
8.
The transfer function of a system consists of poles at –5
–10, and –20 and zeros at –8 and –15. The slope at the
corner frequency 15 changes from
(a)
20 dB to zero
(b) –20 dB to zero
(c)
zero to 20 dB
(d) zero to –20 dB
MCQ 
       EASY
explanation: Practice Question from Control System DPP-17 (Bode Plot (Part-01&02)).
